# REAL CAPTURE — the first non-synthetic fixture in this directory.
#
# Source: GitHub Actions `macos-probe` job (workflow_dispatch), run 31321190309,
# 2026-08-09, runner image macos-15 arm64 (Apple Virtualization.framework guest).
# Produced verbatim by `cargo run -p gpuviewer-core --example macos_probe`.
# This is the §4.5 ground-truth capture the design record asked for; it replaces
# inference about the CI guest with citation. Do not hand-edit — recapture instead.
#
# What it proves (see the cross-platform.md addendum dated 2026-08-09):
#   * libIOReport dlopens on the runner and all 12 bound symbols resolve.
#   * 116 channels total, and NEITHER Tier C GPU selector matches any of them:
#     no `GPU Energy` under `Energy Model` (power), no `GPUPH` under
#     `GPU Stats`/`GPU Performance States` (DVFS residency). Tier C is genuinely
#     unreachable in the paravirt guest — None here is correct, not a bug.
#   * The GPU that DOES exist is AppleParavirtDevice, matched on
#     `paravirtualizedgraphics,gpu`; `AGXAccelerator` is absent entirely
#     (`ioreg -r -c AGXAccelerator -d 2` returned nothing).
#   * Its IOAccelerator node carries a live `Internal Statistics` group —
#     the `In use system memory` / `Alloc system memory` channels below are the
#     Tier B memory source, and they read real values on this runner
#     (In use = 35195904, Alloc = 28278784, driver = 0). An assertion that Tier B
#     memory is None on CI would be WRONG.
#   * `Device Utilization %` is NOT among the PerformanceStatistics keys, so
#     utilization correctly falls through to Tier C, which is also absent -> None.
#
# Unlike the synthetic fixtures, this file carries no planted decoys: it is
# whatever the machine actually reported, noise included.
